Rejects an unknown external finding offset encoding

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_with_external_redaction, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig
from xberg import XbergError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        input = ExtractInput(bytes=[90, 97, 114, 110, 97, 107], filename="external-findings-invalid.txt", kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"), mime_type="text/plain")
        config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{}")
        findings_json = '[{"category":"inspection_person","text":"Zarnak","confidenceScore":0.99,"warnings":[]}]'
        offset_encoding = "bytes-ish"
        max_findings = 8
        await extract_with_external_redaction(input, config, findings_json, offset_encoding, max_findings)
    except XbergError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
